summary: Service lines as a row of tall photo cards that travel sideways while the visitor scrolls: on wide screens the section pins under the header and vertical scrolling moves the row from right to left, with a thin progress bar under it. Each card: photo, title, short text, optional link. Tablets, phones and reduced motion get a swipeable row that snaps to each card. Use for 3-6 service lines that each have a real photo.
